name: GPU-based Octree Generation
definition: An algorithm to generate an Octree data structure on the GPU by partitioning the volume into equal-sized cubes of 32x32x32, unlike Sparse Voxel Octrees which only subdivide non-empty regions.
summary: GPU-based Octree Generation constructs a fixed-partition octree on the GPU by uniformly subdividing the entire volume, simplifying logic by avoiding dynamic branching for empty regions.
